g.text: S How global Batch8 becomes two independent per-device dynamic batches

text.style: font-size: 24px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35445a

g.text: 16 observed launches | two rank rows | read each row left to right: B1 -> B2 -> B3 -> B4

text.style: font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #35445a

g.text: X: categorical launch order within each rank; Y: categorical DCU / rank. Card width is constant and does not encode duration.

text.style: font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #35445a

g.text: Each card gives the actual client-relative timestamp (seconds), request phase and launch-local B. No scheduler state is interpolated.
